title: armor profile switcher
description: Adds 2 or 4 profiles. Quickly change your armor.
body:
Adds 2 or 4 profiles, allowing you to instantly switch between multiple armor sets. You save the profiles. This lets you instantly change the sets in your inventory with a single button press, depending on the situation.

v1 - 2 profiles

v2 - 4 profiles
